{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|US Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Breakfast|Breakfast]] | [[Cookbook:Omelet Recipes|Omelet Recipes]]

The '''Denver omelet''' is a bit like the [[Cookbook:Spanish Omelet|Spanish omelet]], but with different non-[[Cookbook:Egg|egg]] ingredients.

== Ingredients ==
*4 large [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*½ cup chopped red [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]]
*½ cup chopped green bell peppers
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] cooked [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]]
*8 slices cooked [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], drained and crumbled
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
*a couple drops of your favorite [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|hot sauce]] (optional) 
      
==Procedure==
#Melt butter in a large [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] or on a [[Cookbook:Griddle|griddle]].
#[[Cookbook:Sauté|Sauté]] onion, bell pepper, ham and bacon in the butter until the onion starts to become translucent.
#In a small bowl, [[Cookbook:Whipping|whip]] the eggs lightly. Add salt, pepper, and hot sauce if desired. 
#Slowly stir the eggs into the mixture in the skillet.
#Lightly [[Cookbook:Browning|brown]] on one side.
#Flip over and lightly brown other side.
